findings.title: The ?html-proxy exception is a bare query-key test, so any in-scope module id carrying html-proxy that does not match Vite's strict html-proxy shape falls to Vite reading the file by name, which leaks under a swap race.
findings.evidence: ts/vite.config.ts:490 params.has('html-proxy') return null; Vite vite:html-inline-proxy matches only its strict htmlProxyRE. GET /data/race.ts?html-proxy under the withToggler race served the secret module; its sourcemap sourcesContent carried the secret.
findings.consequence: Every module-extension file under the allow-list is exposed to the swap race by appending ?html-proxy.
